name: Fawn Veerasunthorn
bio:
Prasansook "Fawn" Veerasunthorn (Thai: ประสานสุข วีระสุนทร (ฝน)) (born October 6, 1981) is a Thai film director and animator. She worked on the Disney Animation films Frozen (2013), Moana (2016), and Zootopia (2016) as a storyboard artist, and as head of story on Raya and the Last Dragon (2021). The first feature film she directed was Disney's Wish (2023), in collaboration with Chris Buck.
